1. Client sends GET request with query params
2. learning_loop.py:get_impulse_mappings() receives request
3. impulse_learning.get_mapping_records() queries SurrealDB
4. Records filtered by pattern keyword
5. Messages extracted from each record (user message + context files)
6. pattern_extraction_service.extract_patterns(messages) called
7. Sub-functions executed: extract_file_paths, extract_components, identify_common_patterns, calculate_complexity
8. PatternData object constructed
9. ImpulseMappingResponse built with extracted_patterns field
10. JSON response returned to client
